title: Audit the unpacked iOS 16.5 userland for launchd/dyld readiness: Mach-O load commands and LC_LOAD_DYLIB closure of /sbin/launchd, /usr/lib/dyld, backboardd and SpringBoard against the shared cache image list, minimum OS and platform, and the system-call stubs used by libsystem_kernel in the cache against the project kernel's syscalls.master. Read-only; uses the extracted files and, if needed, a pip-installed Mach-O parser in a venv.
acceptance: For each of the four programs the report lists load commands, platform/minos, dyld info type, imported libraries, and which of them are present in the dyld shared cache image list; missing items are named.

The system-call numbers invoked by the cache's libsystem_kernel stubs are listed and compared with the project kernel's table; every mismatch is named, and the result is labelled as a static comparison, not a runtime test.
Dyld's expectations of the kernel (commpage fields, shared-region mapping, entitlements and code-signing checks it queries) are listed from the extracted binaries and tied to the IOS-003 rows.
steps: Map the closure to the cache
